cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag to the platform. Zip it fully, please; the books belong inside it, not on the stairs. My shoulder can manage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's full of dictionaries. Let me take it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep the tickets flat for the scanner. I'll change shoulders at the bottom; it's only the one staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved us to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Check for a lift before choosing more stairs, please. I'll carry it across either way; my other shoulder has had almost a minute's rest.
